commands.name: build
commands.help: render the harness (same flags as geneseed-build; an omitted flag takes the generator default, not the install's — see geneseed status --json for an install's own; dry run: geneseed validate)

options.help: default loop trust preset: how much a loop may do before it stops to ask (default balanced)
switch on opt-in kits, comma-separated; 'none' turns every kit off (default: no kits)

let a per-repo install also read the machine-wide shared tier: on|off (default: off; refused for a global or bundle emit). Benefit: This project sees your machine-wide rules, profile and memory map, so what you taught one tool or repo applies here too. Cost: About 1 500 tokens at every session start, growing with your rules. The hook budget is fixed at 9 000 characters, and the tier loads before this project's docs, so a large tier can push them down to a lazy listing.
the config dir a -global emit writes to (default: the host's resolved one)

switch Law I's secret scan off for this install: a credential-shaped write stops being refused (Sealed Secrets' text still binds); written to the carrier as 'Secrets gate: off' and replayed by rebuilds

switch Law III's done gate off for this install: a turn may end with the project's declared checks unproven (Verify Before Asserting's text still binds); written to the carrier as 'Done gate: off' and replayed by rebuilds

switch Law IV's deletion gate off for this install: the real-loss checks stop asking (Deletion Is Deliberate's text still binds); written to the carrier as 'Deletion gate: off' and replayed by rebuilds

switch the ownership first-write gate off for this install: an application repo with no '## Ownership' section in its root AGENTS.md is no longer stopped once per session before its first write (not a law's gate); written to the carrier as 'Ownership gate: off' and replayed by rebuilds

switch External Gate's hook off for this install: protected checks and the gates' own configuration stop asking, on every host (the doctrine's text still binds unless excluded; OpenCode's own permission.edit keys stay); written to the carrier as 'External gate: off' and replayed by rebuilds

switch the weakened-test note off for this install, at edit time and at turn end (Cure the Cause's text still binds; the done checks still run); written to the carrier as 'Test note: off' and replayed by rebuilds
